name: perry
description_en: A native TypeScript/JavaScript compiler written in Rust. Compiles TypeScript/JavaScript directly to executables using SWC and LLVM.
readme_excerpt: Perry Write TypeScript. Ship native. Everywhere. Perry compiles the TypeScript you already write into real machine-code executables — for macOS, Windows, Linux, iOS, Android, watchOS, and TV. No Node.js to install. No Electron to bundle. No runtime at all. Just a binary. (The same codebase can also target the web, emitted as JavaScript or WebAssembly.) Website · Documentation · Showcase · Examples The language you know.
